name: 3-in-1 Handheld Vacuum
subtitle: Cordless USB rechargeable compact cleaner
description: This 3-in-1 handheld vacuum is a cordless, USB-rechargeable cleaner for quick dust and debris removal in cars, homes, and offices. Its compact design supports everyday cleaning, while three included attachments help reach different surfaces and tighter spaces.
story: Designed for small cleanups without bringing out a full-size vacuum, this handheld cleaner suits car interiors, desks, and other compact spaces. The cordless rechargeable design makes it easier to move between areas, while the included brush tool, flat nozzle, and extension tube provide different cleaning options. A reusable washable filter supports repeated use, and the supplied USB charging cable allows convenient recharging. Its compact format also makes it practical to store in a vehicle, bag, or workspace.
highlights: Reusable washable filter for repeated use
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
